protocol.experiment: WBCAtt+ and BCCD only, camera-background repair, RGB160 15Hz single-cell FPGA
protocol.excluded_source: No Raabin image or Raabin-trained initialization. Previous Raabin+BCCD model is preserved for rollback/comparison only.
protocol.initialization: WBCAtt-only seed20261021 FP32 checkpoint; its original initialization was random, warmstart=None
protocol.split: Keep existing author WBCAtt and frozen BCCD scene splits; all derived crops follow parents; audit decoded/raw and actual RGB160 duplicates across the two sources before training
protocol.duplicates: Exact cross-split duplicates exclude lower priority entire parent group, TEST > VAL > TRAIN; within same split prefer original positive over derived negative; conflicting typed labels excluded. No performance-based exclusions.
protocol.BCCD_labels: WBC box/objectness only; five-class labels remain -1 and class loss is masked
protocol.mosaic: Only typed WBCAtt positive slots, 30%; never replaces negative/BCCD slots
protocol.augmentation: 50% of acquired batches use camera_augment.py with gain0.43..1.15 and gamma0.80..1.45, per-channel variation, blur/noise, 40% dark-surround panels. Other 50% mild; mosaic typed positives only.
protocol.negative_loss: 2*mean positive objectness BCE +0.5*mean negative BCE +2.0*maximum-anchor BCE on each empty image; do not dilute a single false box across20 anchors
protocol.checkpoint_selection: VAL only at objectness0.85; same gate-aware 0.55 natural jointF1+0.20 BCCD localizationF1+0.25 fixed cameraVAL jointF1-0.3 proceduralVAL_FP-0.1 acquired_negative_FP
protocol.final_threshold: Explicit DEVELOPMENT calibration: public and fixed camera-augmented VAL plus provided room/cell screenshots, same grid0.40..0.95 step0.025, no TEST. Screenshots never train weights or supply cell type.

gate.RTL_and_hardware: Exact integer vectors including all five classes and empty inputs; full720p schedule; all regression sources matched; final setup/hold>=0; source/model/bit hashes match; TD6.2 chip PH1P35MDG324

protocol.test_policy: WBCAtt and BCCD TEST have already been examined in previous experiments; evaluate selected frozen model only as reused regression. Never claim a new untouched test or use TEST to select weights/thresholds.
protocol.camera_probes: User screenshots contain OSD, not raw clean RGB; historical cell type unknown. Development checks are not camera accuracy measurement.
protocol.runtime: All detection/classification/background rejection/tracking/overlay in FPGA; unchanged 15Hz, single cell box, English full names; original .al only; SRAM only
protocol.name: wbc_bccd160_devcam_20261021
protocol.camera_repair: Only WBCAtt+BCCD pixels. More underexposed positive cells and rectangular photographed-panel geometry; no screenshot pixel used for training; screenshots development-only and have influenced augmentation design.
protocol.natural_replay: Extra16 typed natural WBCAtt images per batch, true-box/type loss weighted0.5; no teacher or pseudo label
protocol.frozen_parameters: All first9 layers, final-head bbox filters and all five class filters remain byte-identical; train only head channels4,14,24, weights and bias; no weight decay

release_scope: Engineering SRAM trial; original1% artificial-background gate failed,2% trial bound explicitly disclosed

postprocess.class_selection: argmax of five neural class logits
